ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Macro-level ratio of approximately 45 percent high-intensity (white and tan) to 55 percent low-intensity (dark grey and black) pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white region occupies the central-lateral area of the left lobe. A distinct, contiguous tan-colored high-intensity region is located at the distal tip of the right lobe. Low-intensity black pigmentation forms a continuous border along the leading and trailing edges of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: A sharp V-shaped depression with an estimated interior angle of 72 degrees and a bounding-box depth approximately 1/6th of the total vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Low-frequency, moderate-amplitude serrations (notches) are concentrated on the lateral extremities of the trailing edge. The medial trailing edges exhibit lower frequency pixel-amplitude variations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex sweep along the trailing boundary of both lobes, terminating in pointed posterior-lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small, circular, high-contrast white pixel clusters (~2-4 pixels in diameter) are visible within the dark pigment zones of the terminal lobe tips and right trailing edge.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several unaligned, low-intensity linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are visible; one set of diagonal lines on the left lobe and one set of near-vertical lines on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Asymmetric yellowish-tan patch on the distal right lobe; irregular indentations along the right trailing edge suggesting minor historical tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant color variance in high-intensity regions, specifically the tan hue on the right lobe distal field compared to the white field on the left lobe.
